exposure: COVID-19 omicron variant infection during pregnancy
cohort: 79 pregnant women infected with the COVID-19 omicron variant and their 68 neonates
finding: Most pregnant women with COVID-19 omicron infection experienced mild or no symptoms, and while most neonates were healthy, there were cases of stillbirth and neonatal SARS-CoV-2 infection.
mod_finding: Of the women who delivered, 34 cases underwent cesarean section and 31 cases underwent vaginal delivery.
gest_age: Majority in third trimester, 15% in first or second trimester
